replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
Looking pretty decent. The shape of the hub is cool, and I like how you incorporated ice.

Although, it doesn't have the greatest aesthetics. We want something that appeals to players, as they join onto Avicus. Maybe make your trees a bit more advanced, rather than just a regular grown spruce tree, with wool thrown on it. I feel like pathways maybe a bit too small, if you take a look at our current hub, pathways are quite wide. This provides more room for decoration as well as more space for players to explore.

I think something else that is popular with the community, is little secrets hidden within the hub. Maybe include some nice little Christmas secrets in your lobby. Also maybe take your mountains, and make them a bit more natural, they kinda look bubbly and simple. Add a few more structures too, more area's to explore! :)

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Hubs rely entirely on aesthetics considering a gameplay side isn't on play and their purpose is pretty much to appeal as much as possible to the eye of the players.
I hope I don't sound rude or anything but it doesn't really make me wow at all. The mountains are way too spherey, you can tell they were worldedited right away. The block combos aren't making up for anything, it is way too small for a lobby, lacks lighting severely, not an optimal shape (as lobbies are generally prefered to be symmetrical rather than random.
There's simply too much lacking on this, and lobbies have to pretty much have excellent aesthetics or they won't do any good. I'll give you a honest no and if you really want to take on doing a hard task which is making a lobby then you'll need to pretty much rebuild it and put ten times as much detail, structure and texture to the map, not to mention secrets, lighting, and fun areas.

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body: Small tip on the mountains. Take sand and form the shape of the mountains you want, and then replace your sand with ice, stone and whatever else. It gives the mountains a really nice and natural feel. Trust me it will look a lot better! :)
